default.text: A real Lightborn! Go on, then. Die and come back. No? Pip said you'd be scarier.

options.text: It doesn't work like a trick.

trick.text: Shame. Tobias bet me a copper you'd glow. You don't even glow.

work.text: Everything Uncle Hamm doesn't, which is most of it. Milk, fence, the far field. I'm seventeen and I've never been past the south gate.

options.text: The road will still be there.
Learn a blade first. Then go.
Past the gate is where people like you get eaten.

work_kind.text: That's what old people say. You're not even old.

work_plain.text: With what, a hay fork? ...Would you show me? Not now. Uncle's looking.

work_hard.text: People like me. Right. Mind the cows, sky-man.
